# Widget configuration

<Note title="Attribute text that is never chunked">
The widget server listens on **port 8080** by default.
</Note>

Set `WIDGET_HOME` to change the data directory of the [widget server](https://example.com/widget).

- Run `widget start` to launch the server.
- Run `widget stop` to stop it.

> Logs are written to   _the logs directory_.

```sh
widget start --host example.com
```
